viewing_check: Read the pencil edition number (?/16) and date clearly, and the title. Check the sheet size and image size, any printer or workshop chop, and that the signature is in pencil and the print is original (not a reproduction or poster). Look for foxing, mount burn, or staining under the glass, and photograph the back of the frame for labels or gallery provenance.
